_week: 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-01 (Week 44), MAC Energy US. Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Sales rose 7.4% to $103,362 while ad spend fell 22% to $57,085, so TACoS dropped from 76.4% to 55.2%.
Every flavor grew: Green Apple +13%, Proper Punch +8%, Macberry Lychee +8%. The Variety Pack is still 46% of sales.
refunds: Refunds were $1,089 (1.61% of units), down from $1,762 the week before. Nothing here needs action this week.
pacing_reco: November has one day in ($18,160), so the straight-line figure is not a forecast yet. The lever is ad efficiency: October sold $483,507 but paid out a loss after $404,788 of ad spend.
ads_context: Ad spend has come down each week since the Oct 5–11 peak ($150,787), and TACoS went from 100.3% that week to 55.2%.
ACoS is still 128.4%: ads bring in $0.78 of ad sales per $1 spent.
ads_strategy: Category keywords took $30,450 of spend for $15,899 in sales (191.5% ACoS), down 35% in spend vs last week.
Branded keywords returned $5,575 on $1,666 (29.9% ACoS); competitor targeting tripled to $4,624 at 129.8% ACoS.
bid_moves: Lower bids on the “energy drink” exact targets: $17,270 spent for $9,027 in sales this week.
Raise budget on the Orange Creamsicle brand-exact campaign: $566 brought $3,477 (16.3% ACoS).
coupons: This week: 602 coupon orders (703 last week).
promotions: This week: 1,523 promotion orders and $15,633 in promotional discounts (vs 2,159 and $22,555 last week).
Lower discounting helped the payout this week while sales still grew.
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30.
Deal and coupon set-up deadlines: to confirm with the account team.
Priority: the Variety Pack needs stock at FBA before BF/CM; it has about 1–2 weeks left with 400 inbound.
reviews_body: Sellerise shows a 4.5-star rating, shared across the flavors through the Variety Pack listing.
No new reviews are dated in the last 90 days, so there is no trend to read yet.
reviews_reco: Check the review request settings: about 3,650 orders a week and no new reviews logged in 90 days is unusual.
Confirm review tracking covers each flavor ASIN, not only the shared listing.

Cut bids on the “energy drink” / “energy drinks” exact and broad targets running above 170% ACoS.
Move budget to brand searches: “mac energy drink” ran at 17.2% ACoS on $454 for $2,645.
Review the Variety Pack auto campaign: $4,699 spent for $1,342 (350% ACoS).
Pause the 9 no-sale campaigns ($424 this week).
Plan BF/CM coupons and deals (Nov 27–30) around stock on hand.
Load product costs into Sellerise so payout shows profit after COGS.
